genders.name: Male
genders.description: Traditionally associated with biological males and masculinity.

genders.name: Female
genders.description: Traditionally associated with biological females and femininity.

genders.name: Non-Binary
genders.description: A gender identity that is not exclusively male or female. It can be a combination of both, neither, or something else.

genders.name: Genderqueer
genders.description: A gender identity that falls outside of the traditional male/female binary. Often used interchangeably with non-binary.

genders.name: Genderfluid
genders.description: A gender identity that is not fixed and can change over time or depending on the situation.

genders.name: Agender
genders.description: A person who does not identify with any gender or has no gender.

genders.name: Bigender
genders.description: A person who identifies with two genders, either simultaneously or switching between them.

genders.name: Two-Spirit
genders.description: A term used by some Indigenous cultures in North America to describe a person who embodies both masculine and feminine qualities, or who has a unique gender role in their society.

genders.name: Hijra
genders.description: A third gender recognized in South Asia, particularly in India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Hijras have a distinct cultural and social role.

genders.name: Demiboy
genders.description: A gender identity that is partially, but not entirely, male.

genders.name: Demigirl
genders.description: A gender identity that is partially, but not entirely, female.

genders.name: Neutrois
genders.description: A non-binary gender identity where a person feels neutral or has a lack of gender.

genders.name: Androgynous
genders.description: A gender expression that is a blend of both masculine and feminine traits, or neither.

genders.name: Cisgender
genders.description: A person whose gender identity matches the sex they were assigned at birth.

genders.name: Transgender
genders.description: A person whose gender identity differs from the sex they were assigned at birth.

genders.name: Pangender
genders.description: A person who identifies with all genders, or has an expansive gender identity.

genders.name: Skoliosexual
genders.description: A sexual attraction to non-binary people or individuals who don't fit into the traditional male/female binary.

genders.name: Maverique
genders.description: A non-binary gender identity that is independent from both male and female, and exists outside of the traditional binary.

genders.name: Autigender
genders.description: A gender identity that is deeply connected to one's experience of being autistic.

genders.name: Quoigender
genders.description: A gender identity that cannot be fully described or understood.
